CONVERT_TO_SUBTITLE: Applies to messages as they load.
SYSTEM_AUTO_SUBTITLE: Imperial in the US, Liberia and Myanmar; metric everywhere else.
SYSTEM_METRIC_SUBTITLE: Feet, pounds, mph and °F get metric values.
SYSTEM_IMPERIAL_SUBTITLE: Metres, kilograms, km/h and °C get imperial values.
SYSTEM_BOTH_SUBTITLE: Every measurement gets the other system's value.
